## The command

The command you ran, for example `npx penthera --repo .`

## Version

The output of `penthera --version`:

## The finding

- The finding's title:
- Rule id (the `rule` field in the JSON report, or the id in the Markdown report):
- File and line (`file:line`), or the URL:

What the code really does, or what Penthera missed. A few lines of code help,
